$comment: Pack Rat adapter manifest v1: adapters/<id>/capabilities.json, the adapter's contract as data. Read by app/installer.mts (listAdapters, and install's section for candidateClientRoots, validateScriptsDir and installScripts), checked in full by app/contracts.test.mts. capabilities is checked against scan.v2.schema.json's adapter.capabilities shape, its one definition, so this schema only says it is an object. See docs/adapter-guide.md, Manifest reference.

adapter.$comment: The adapter's id, the same as its folder name.

version.$comment: Matches every ADAPTER_VERSION line in the adapter's scripts.

protocol.$comment: The bridge queue-line protocol its bridge reads; declared by an adapter that ships a bridge.

platform.$comment: The one process.platform the client runs on; absent means every platform.

actions.$comment: What the scripts do in the world; app/adapters.test.mts holds the vocabulary.

install.$comment: What the installer knows about this adapter's client. A paste-transport adapter installs nothing and carries only register.

scriptsSuffix.$comment: The folders under a candidate or picked root that hold the scripts, most specific first.

candidateRoot.$comment: The client folder's well-known name, looked for under Desktop, Downloads and Documents (and LOCALAPPDATA and C:\ on win32). Absent: the client has no fixed install location, so nothing is guessed.

retired.$comment: Scripts an earlier version shipped under a name it no longer uses; an install removes one only when its first line is this header.

stopHint.$comment: How to stop this client's running scripts, ending the install's running refusal. Absent: neutral wording.

register.$comment: The client-specific step an install runs once the scripts are in place (app/installer.mts's REGISTRARS).
